paite: Huchi in Kumpipa Solomon tuh Israel tengteng kumpipa ahong hita hi.
heading: Solomon Miliante

paite: Hiaite amiliante ahi uh: Zadok tapa Azariah siampu ahi.
Shisha tapa Elihoreph leh Ahiah laigelhmi ahi uh. Ahilud tapa Jehoshaphat tanchin gelhmi ahi.
Jehoiada tapa Benaiah sepaih heutu ahi a; Zadok leh Abiathar siampu ahi uh.
Nathan tapa Azariah heutute tung a mi ahi a; Nathan tapa Zabud siampu leh kumpipa lawm ahi khawm hi.
Ahishar insung lam heutu ahi a; Abda tapa Adoniram phutluih nasemte heutu ahi.

Solomon in Israel tengteng tung ah heutu sawm-le-nih anei hi. Huaite'n kumpipa a ding leh a-inkote a ding in nek-le-tak angaihtuah zel uhi. Mi khat in kum khat in kha khat zel nek ding tak ding ape zel hi.
Hiaite amin uh ahi: Ephraim tanggam ah Ben-hur.
Makaz, Shaalbim, Beth-shemesh leh Elon-beth-hanan ah dil Ben-deker ahi.
Arubboth ah Ben-hesed ahi a, ama'n Sokoh leh Hepher gam teng leng atangkhawm hi.
Dor gam tengteng ah Ben- abinadab ahi a, ama'n Solomon tanu Taphath zi in anei hi.
Tanak khua leh Meggiddo khote, Jezreel kho nuai, Zarethan khochin a om Beth-shean bial teng ah, Beth-shean apan Abel-meholah, Jokmeam gam bul tan in Ahilud tapa Baana ahi.

Ramoth-gilead ah Ben-geber ahi a, ama'n Manasseh tapa Jair khote, Gilead gam a omte atangkhawm hi. Bashan gam a Argob bial, kho thupi taktak sawmguk, kulh leh akalhna daltawn neite leng atangkhawm hi.
Mahanaim ah Iddo tapa Ahinadab ahi.
Naphtali ah Ahimaaz ahi a, ama'n leng Solomon tanu Basemath zi in anei hi.
Asher leh Bealoth khua ah Hushai tapa Baana ahi a;
Issakar ah Paruah tapa Jehoshaphat;
Benjamin ah Elah tapa Shimei;
Amorte kumpipa Sihon leh Bashan kumpipa Og gam, Gilead gam ah Uri tapa Geber ahi a, Amah huai gam heutu omsun ahi.
Judahte leh Israelte tuipi piau a piaunel zah mahmah in atam ua, ane un adawn ua, nuamtak in a-om zel uhi.
heading: Solomon Vaihawm Lohching

paite: Solomon in lui a pan Philistiate gam leh Aigupta gamgi pha in gam teng ah vai ahawm hi. Thilpiakte ahon tawi zel ua, Solomon damsung teng a-nna asem uhi.
Solomon ni khat an nekkhiak, tangbuang nel mahmah pota sawmthum leh tangbuang pota sawmguk;
bawngtal thautak sawm, gam a bawngtal sawmnih leh belam zakhat ahi uh. Hiaite lou leng sakhite, sangaite, sakhital, ak vak thaute leng ahi lai uhi.
Lui gal khen lam gam teng, Tiphsah a pan Gaza tan, lui gal khen lam a kumpipate tung ah alal hi. Akimvel a mi teng toh kilem in a-om hi.
Solomon damsung in Judahte leh Israelte Dan a pan Beer-sheba tan in michih amau grep leh theipi chinna nuai ah bittak in ateng chiat uhi.
Solomon in kangtalai kai sakol singli leh sakol tungtuangmi singkhat-le-sangnih anei hi.
Hiai heutute'n amau tankha kha in Solomon leh kumpipa Solomon dohkan hong um teng nek ding apia ua, piak kim louh anei ngei kei uh.
Michih in ahih dia seh bang dungzui in a-omna ding mun ah sakolte leh gan taihat mahmahte a ding in barli buh leh buhpawlte ahon pua uhi.
Pathian in Solomon pilna leh theihsiamna thupi mahmah leh lungsim letna tuipi piau a piaunel bang mai apia hi.
Solomon pilna in suahlam ta tengteng pilna leh Aigupta mite pilna tengteng akhup vek hi.
Mi tengteng sang in apilzaw a, Mahol tapate, Ezrah mi Ethan, Heman, Kalkol leh Darda sang in leng. Huchi in akim a nam tengteng lak ah amin athangkheta hi.
Paunak sangthum agen a, alate sangkhat leh nga ahi uh.
Sing tanchin, Lebanon tang a Sidar sing a pan kulhbaang a hong selkhia hissop tan in agen hi. Gamsate tanchin, vasate tanchin, bokvak a paite tanchin leh ngasate tanchin leng agen hi.
Huchi in Solomon pilna ngaikhe ding in nam tengteng a pan apilna zasate leh lei a kumpipa teng ahong pai uhi.
